message.reasoning: SRC_001 explicitly says "I cannot execute code here" — the problem says RUN it and report what actually happened. Strong fault: it predicts rather than runs; the problem demands execution. It's a constructed mental example, not a program run. Also the second constraint: report which commitments would have to exist for (a) and (b) to come apart — it gives counterconditions partly. But the main fault stands.
